goal: Generate and verify a complete docs-first CS2 demo integrity-analysis project through the reviewed Provider bounded-leaf route, including a built-in official-source platform researcher, authorized acquisition adapters, parser normalization, multi-signal explainable risk analysis, offline synthetic end-to-end evidence, and packaging checks.
acceptance_criteria: A built-in platform researcher discovers and refreshes official platform documentation, records cited capability profiles with freshness and authorization requirements, and produces reviewable adapter proposals for unknown platforms.
A CLI runs download/import, parse, analyze, and JSON/HTML report workflows; synthetic legitimate and suspicious trajectories exercise the complete offline pipeline.

Detection combines crosshair angular dynamics, target alignment, reaction timing, tracking, target switching, pre-aim/prefire, visibility, occlusion uncertainty, and information-relation signals into explainable evidence rather than a definitive cheating accusation.
Generated tests, runtime evidence, quality report, and packaging checks pass through the existing Provider and post-build route.

Platform acquisition uses explicit adapters for local files, authorized HTTPS downloads, Steam match-history sharing codes, and FACEIT-authorized demo links without hidden scraping or embedded credentials.

The generated project follows a docs-first layout with architecture, source authorization, data contracts, detection rationale, calibration limits, model card, and test plan before src implementation.

The parser normalizes real demoparser2 output and deterministic fixture input into one tick/event schema covering view angles, player positions, teams, shots, visibility or information state, deaths, and rounds.

feedback: The complete offline synthetic workflow, 50-test reviewed suite, isolated runtime, browser evidence, canonical package, and complexity contract passed.
Live Steam/FACEIT credentials, a production real-demo corpus, and population-calibrated error rates remain explicitly not evaluated.

The local CLI continuation did not enter through Codex conversation production capture, so the public delivery gate correctly remains NEEDS_REWORK on production_candidate_provenance; no provenance was fabricated.

worked: Docs-first component planning produced architecture, source authorization, data contract, detection rationale, model-card, quality, and test artifacts before the reviewed src implementation.
Tree-structured bounded leaves, interface feedforward, affected-only feedback, and librarian-scoped context completed a 103-entry canonical package without a large global prompt.

The project-local official-source researcher, authorization-aware acquisition adapters, optional real-demo parser, normalized evidence pipeline, explainable multi-signal analysis, and human-review reports passed the 50-test quality suite.
Formal isolated runtime and browser capture verified the same candidate hash, and local_packager produced a canonical PASS bundle inspected independently.
The full CGKN suite completed with 1063 passed and 381 skipped after the generic mainline repairs.
did_not_work: A medium-complexity test leaf copied schema validation logic into a 400-plus-line module and exhausted the bounded Provider response even at the hard token cap.
A synthetic trajectory fixture attempted to serialize a match-scale tick stream into one JSON leaf, exposing the same missing per-kind size contract for data fixtures.
A high-complexity CLI test suite still exhausted the Provider hard output cap after code and fixture size prompts, showing that validation alone cannot replace structural subdivision.

The first structurally split test part still expanded toward whole-project coverage because the leaf prompt described project-level constraints as requirements for every individual file and repeated unrelated static-web test guidance.

Even after responsibility wording was corrected, each leaf still received the complete raw project goal, including the project-wide forty-test acceptance target, which encouraged a single test part to reproduce suite-level scope.
One remaining cancel/resume test leaf repeatedly surfaced only as PROVIDER_UNKNOWN_ERROR because leaf-attempt diagnostics were not emitted before the component-level retry reducer.

After structural subdivision, one complete cancel/resume test part measured 329 nonblank lines and was repeatedly rejected by the earlier 220-line test cap even though it fit the Provider token budget and the product-module hard cap.

Budgeted semantic review treated unselected or truncated code as missing implementation, assigned backend artifact production to foundation, required backend/frontend-owned tests despite canonical tests ownership, and initiated an overbroad all-component repair.

The original foundation metadata invented a console-script package not owned by foundation, while the frontend manifest used URL-fragment-like pseudo paths and produced a self-importing src/app.js facade.

Large-module consumers repeatedly guessed unpublished convenience symbols, including importing validate_input from the wrong stage partition and run_gui from a GUI module that published run_gui_story_analysis.

A component retry combined newly generated early leaves with an older cached stages_part_04.py because split-file checkpoints were individually reusable even when an earlier checkpoint in the same component was missing.

Frontend manifests naturally expressed both HTML asset references and JavaScript DOM dependencies as file dependencies, creating a three-file generation-order cycle; cached non-Python leaves were also not rechecked against the current boundary contract before reuse.

The high-complexity src/app.js leaf defined six public symbols and repeatedly exhausted the 7000-token Provider file budget because automatic symbol-group expansion originally accepted only Python sources.

The reviewed run_local_pipeline.py facade did not expose the implementation's resume-run-dir argument, so an attempted command silently started fresh planning instead of resuming the saved leaf graph.

A saved component-file repair plan was later wrapped by a provider-semantic-repair envelope whose outer stage overwrote the nested leaf stage during load, discarding the exact component, manifest, and remaining-file continuation state.

After the nested plan and leaf manifests matched, one live resume still scheduled the first frontend leaf; the previous evidence log did not distinguish a split-checkpoint identity miss from a component-checkpoint fallback or later boundary invalidation.

The resume command recomposed its project plan, and nondeterministic optional local-planning output changed component specification hashes; this invalidated otherwise verified upstream and completed-leaf checkpoints even though the run identity, goal, and accepted leaf manifest were unchanged.

After frontend completion, the downstream tests component was about to request a newly designed manifest even though the prior run retained an exact passing manifest entry for every test leaf, risking an unintended reduction of the original broad test suite.

The first fully reviewed run used an artifacts directory as the requested materialization target, and the generated-root safety guard correctly refused to clean or write there; the subsequent materialization-only retry needed an explicit same-run resume identity after the pending leaf plan had already been cleared.
A valid 1280x2370 CS Demo Integrity screenshot was deleted because the generic capture gate still required Task, Todo, Doing, or Done text inherited from a task-board scenario.

The canonical test runner ignored the generated project's declared pytest testpaths and preferred an exploratory provider-generated tests directory, so 50 reviewed quality tests passed while formal evidence incorrectly ran 232 unrelated guessed-interface tests.
Canonical runtime evidence truncated a long HTML response to 4000 characters but hashed the untruncated body, making an otherwise passing isolated runtime impossible for the inspector to reproduce.
The successful provider-generation result exposed a lower-case pass without explicit NOT_EVALUATED delivery fields, which could be misread as a completed post-build or formal delivery decision.
The modular post-build wrapper accepted video_requested for its evidence policy but forwarded the option to a legacy function that did not accept that keyword.
experiments: Apply test-code and test-fixture-specific nonblank-line budgets; require parametrized public-interface tests and minimal representative event sequences; automatically split high-complexity pytest suites into core, boundary, and integration modules with a non-collecting anchor; treat global goal constraints as non-contradiction invariants; retain the full raw goal locally while sending leaf generation only a goal hash, bounded purpose excerpt, accepted contracts, manifest responsibility, and librarian evidence; emit a bounded redacted failure event for each leaf attempt; calibrate structurally split test leaves to a 360-line default and 480-line hard cap; downgrade semantic-review uncertainty and cross-owner claims to warnings; reject URL-fragment manifest paths and JavaScript self-imports; forbid foundation from inventing downstream console-script targets; project every declared dependency into an exact provider-path-to-published-symbol table in the leaf prompt; reuse only a contiguous component checkpoint prefix during ordinary resume and invalidate cached interface-mismatch sources plus their downstream closure; normalize native frontend generation dependencies to HTML, then styles, then scripts, and re-run every cached leaf's language-specific boundary receipt before reuse; extend high-complexity symbol-group expansion to real JavaScript ES-module siblings and retain src/app.js as the stable non-self-importing facade; expose the implementation's resume-run-dir option through the reviewed CLI facade; when semantic repair wraps a component-file plan, preserve the nested leaf stage and exact component-scoped continuation fields as authoritative; emit a bounded per-leaf cache-source and identity scan before deciding reuse or invalidation; persist the composed generation plan for later resumes, gate optional local planning by the explicit planning task, and recover legacy same-run upstream/leaf identity only when raw goal and exact manifest-entry hashes still match; reconstruct a downstream manifest only when every graph leaf has an exact passing manifest-entry checkpoint, then re-run current boundary and real-test gates; honor safe project-local pytest testpaths before the tests fallback; hash the exact stored bounded runtime observation; label materialization pass as evidence NOT_EVALUATED until post-build and packaging; consume wrapper-owned optional video policy before legacy invocation.
